content.comment_body: Hello everyone, if I plan to purchase 100 [product_name] controllers, is it possible to configure the date and time on each unit using a memory or battery card containing my program? Or do I need to manually interact with each controller, either via the front panel or the [product_name] software? Thanks!
Setting the date and time through a memory module is not possible.

Thank you, [user_name]. On a related subject, do you see any major drawbacks between the PURE and BASIC controllers? I'm considering PURE devices for my project due to budget constraints. So far, the only disadvantage I notice is that PURE requires all configuration to be done using the [product_name] software on a laptop, with no direct interface on the device. Thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for a streamlined way to set date and time on large numbers of [product_name] controllers, hoping for automated setup via memory modules. Since this feature is unavailable, users must perform repetitive manual setup, which is inefficient for bigger projects. Additionally, there are concerns about the PURE models, which cannot be configured directly and must be managed exclusively through a software application.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to program date and time settings on multiple controllers automatically, without needing manual setup for each device. They are also looking for affordable hardware solutions that still offer essential usability, such as the ability to interface directly with the device.
